tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa ye/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /bstan srung rnam mang thos sras la btud nas/ /de nyid mnyes byed mchod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'dir spel lo/ /'dir rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba nyams su len pa la/ rten gyi gang zag dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa phyag na rdo rje dang chos skyong chen po'i rjes gnang thob pa/ khyad par gyi dam tshig stod g.yogs sngon po bgo ba lung thang gi phreng ba bgrang ba/ rta'i sha mi za ba/ yugs sa mos phyag tshang byas pa'i zas mi za ba/ re ba nag po'i stan la mi 'dug pa/ snod kha chag tu zas mi za ba/ mi ro rta ro la mi 'ju ba ste dam tshig bdun dang ldan pa/ phyi rten rta sngon po dngos sam gzugs/ nang rten cho ga dang mthun par byas pa'i bris sku/ gsang rten bshad pa ltar byas pa'i bai yig sngags dang bcas pa'i ga'u ste/ rten gsum tshang ba btsugs shing 'dir sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas yar ngo'i gza' skar bzang po la gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku dgram/ grub na zhes 'dam kha mdzad pa 'di 'og tu bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog rgyas par byed pa'am yi dam mi byed/ byed na maṇ+ḍal 'di bsham/ mi byed na 'di bsham mi dgos zhes pa'i zur bstan 'dra yang / deng sang bsod nams tshogs gsog rgyas pa de mi byed bzhin du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bshams pas lhag par song zhing / da nas dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung bzhin tshogs gsog de'ang bgyid rgyu yin pas maṇ+ḍal 'di bsham chog de bzhin du gtor bshams kyi skabs/

yi dam chos skyong zhes pa nas/ spyi la re re zhes pa'i bar 'di gtor bsngo'i gtor ma yin kyang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis bskang gso'i gtor ma lta bur bzhed 'dra zhing / de gras yi dam la gtor bsham mdzad kyang bsngo rgyu mi 'dug pas/ da nas dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung bzhin yi dam la'ang gtor bsngo dang chos skyong la'ang gtor bsngo dang bskang ba so so'i rnam dbye 'og na bris yod pas bsham 'di dag bsgyur mi dgos/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa la gtso 'khor dgu'i tshom bu bkod/ yi dam/ chos skyong / rta bdag brgyad/ 'khor spyi rnams la che zhing bzang ba'i gtor ma re re'am/ ma 'byor na yi dam chos skyong spyi la re re/ bskang bshags la dgos pa'i khang bzang gi dbyibs su byas pa'i bskang gtor che ba phyag len bzhin dang / chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang / dung chos su dri bzang sbyar ba'i chu 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/ spyan gzigs dang / rdo rje dril bu rol mo'i bye brag la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang / rmig zlum dang mdzo rtol gyi sha dang chang ma gtogs pa'i tshogs rdzas ci 'byor pa bshams la/ yo byad rnams la dri bzang gi chu gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i gsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying khar g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis bsang gtor 'thor tshul oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mchod yon gyi rgya/ pā d+yaṃ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan nas g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis mtheb mdzub kyis chu len tshul byas nas steng nas 'og tu bskor te g.yas mdzub mo nas rim gyis gyen du bkrol/

g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying khar kha gyen bstan g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung nas rim bzhin bkrol lo/ aṃ tsa ma naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta'i mthar rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms/ shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po las/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par aḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim par bsam/

slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi a bhi ṣīñtsa maṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim par bsam zhing / oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lung thang gi phreng ba la ci nus bsgrangs/ mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sngon du 'gro ba'i/ deng sang oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi lan gcig las brjod srol mi 'dug kyang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa nyer spyod so so'i sngags mgor/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi zhes pa 'di sbyor dgos rgyu yin oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ gtor ma rnams 'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ khaṃ las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin du brtsegs pa/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas/ yi ge gsum zhu nas nyes skyon thams cad dag par gyur/ thal mo khong stong gi phyag rgya dang /

oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ nas/ oṃ a hūm̐ gi bar lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis sbyar te brkyang ba'i rgyab tu so so'i mdzub mo gnyis bkug la sbyar mthe bong dang mthe chung gnyis so sor sbyar te bsgreng ba sangs rgyas spyan ma'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba ar+tha sa dha na ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gong 'jig rten la gang dgos su bsgyur/ thal mo kha stong las g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo dbus ma gsum gyi bar tshigs bcag pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu kha bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis rgya chen por spel/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'thor g.yab kyis bsangs chu gtor la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ādzñā pa ya ti/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pas phul/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod gong bzhin/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ḥbacom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan/ /zhe sdang can rnams 'dul ba'i rtags/ /nyon mongs spangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /rdo rje lan gsum gsor bas ni/ /gnod sbyin drag po 'dul mdzad pa/ /gnod sbyin gos sngon phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni/ /ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs na/ /rgyal po btul nas nor sgrub mdzad/

/gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldanྎ /me ri 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs/ /rnam rgyal khro ba'i skur bstan nas/ /khro bo'i ngar skad drag po yis/ /thams cad kun 'dul phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldanྎ /mkha' lding rgyal po'i skur sprul nas/ /klu rgyal thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje bsnams laྎ /bcom ldanྎ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag tu/ /nag po chen po'i skur sprul nas/ /rū tra 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa rdzogs pa'am gang rigs kyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod de nas rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis 'khyil ba'i sngags dang dri bzang gi chu phyogs kun tu bsang gtor byas la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ dngos grub 'dod 'jo las sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa sgrub gzhung rnams su 'byung yang deng sang phyag len thams cad mthun par mi mdzad grub na phun sum tshogs pas mdzad par spro na dgos 'dod 'byung ba bzhin lags zhes gsungs pa de dkon mchog lhun grub kyi 'di kha sor bzhag yin/ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/ de nas sngags byin gyis brlab pa'i mchod pa rnams/ 'khyil ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ āṃ tsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rnams spel la mchod/ 'dir tshig 'ga' mi gsal ba'i bri ma thub/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ /gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing / /sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa/

/'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang / /bka' 'bangs bran slad rang lus nyer bdog bcas/ /ma chags mi zhum zab cing rgya che'i phyir/ /dgongs chen bsgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod/ /rang gi rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bras 'dod dang / /don med don log cung zad don phyir ni/ /ha cang 'dod chos skye dang chog ma shes/ /bsam sbyor nongs pa gang mchis mthol lo bshags/ /lha klu mi rnams 'jig dang phongs pa las/ /myur skyob 'jig rten skyong rgyal 'jig rten las/ /kun sgrol kun nas phan dang bde ster ba/ /phrin las rgyun mi chad la rjes yi rang / /sna tshogs yang dag 'jig dang mgon med dang / /sdig sdug brel phongs rgyas gzir skal ngan rnams/ /dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku dang 'od/ /nyi zla rgyal mtshan ne'u le rnam rol bskul/ /khyod sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gyings/ /sgeg 'dul rten 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis/ /mi bsrun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes bzung phyir/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /de ltar 'gro skyob khyed la 'gro bde'i bslad/ /lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsnyen bskur bas/ /bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzod rtag tu yang / /shes rab thugs rjes mi bsnyel mi gtong shog /bdag gi gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du phog pas thams cad 'od du zhu nas stong pa nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni sngon 'gro tshogs gsog pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las mdun du bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs ma dgu yod pa/

dbus ma'i pho brang sum brtsegs su gnas pa'i rtse mor nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ logs rnams su drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang shing / mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma ra ga byang gser las grub pa'i ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas phyogs re rer brgyan pa/ gter gyi khang pa bco lnga bco lngas brgyan spras pa/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rin po che'i ljon shing brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po ljon shing dang me tog gis brgyan pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa/ phyi nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba/ pho brang dbus ma'i nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bai yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bai yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po ngal gso po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas dgos 'dod thams cad stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhal las rin po che'i char 'bebs shing / skye dgu thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las sgrol ba/ dbu la rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol zhing / sku la rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon gnyis la nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ seng ge dkar po nyal thabs su gnas te de nyid la gdong lta ba'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa'o/

/phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs rnams su pad+ma'i gdan re re'i steng du/ shar du rmug 'dzin ser po g.yas rin po che/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu/ byang du ku bai ra nag po ral gri/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po gser gri/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung / nub byang du lnga rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil pa dkar po gri phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas pas rang rang gis phyag mtshan dang g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi mdog dang mtshungs pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la chibs pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can no/ /'khor sa bar pa la gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs rnams dang / 'khor sa tha ma la sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / stobs chenasum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa lha srin sde brgyad dang / gnod sbyin dang srin po'i tshogs mi sdug cing brjid la rngams pa/ phyag g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing / g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku mdog mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ gzhan yang rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel/ rnam sras mthing kha yab yum gtso 'khor/ mgon po gar mkhan mchog zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa lha brgyad/ gar mkhan mchog dmar smug yab yum/ rnam sras dreg byed seng zhon klu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ bzhon pa spang ba'i dregs byed 'khor klu brgyad dang bcas pa/ rnam sras drag po yang gsang srin po bzhis bskor/ rnam sras mthing nag bdud mo bzhis bskor/ ma mo ltar sgrub pa lha dgu/ rnam sras mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ rnam sras dmar po las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa/ gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa lha bcu gsum/ rnam sras ljang yul mar grags pa gser chen lha dgu/

rnam sras ljang ser be con can te rnam sras kyi rigs mi 'dra ba gtso 'khor de thams cad kyang sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa dbyar gyi na bun chen po 'thib pa ltar mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ man ngag las byung ba'i spos sam med na 'bras phye dang spos dkar bsres pas bsreg cing rol mo dang bcas te/ rang phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi sna la 'dod rgyal dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa spros pas des byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te mdun du bskyed pa'i rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ rgyal po 'gug pa'i phyag rgya'am/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca' zhing / spro na rnga rdung dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'dir rol mo rdo rje phur pas/ dkar dung nas 'dra/ rkang gling sogs dang bcas gser skyems kyi mgo ltar rol mo bcas la nyis brdeg lan can brdeg la srin thung ma'i gdangs dang bcas pa mdzad/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing / /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la phan slad du/ /ngal bso rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir rol mo nyis brdeb dang chems brdung / de nas che ba gnyis brdeb la bzhag oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod/ bai ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'dzum sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yun tsam brjod pas rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bai bzhi bzhi bsam zhing /

dam tshig dang ye shes pa'i thugs kar 'od zer gyi lcags kyus dbyer med du byas par gyur/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis mthe'u chung la g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mos bzung ba lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca'/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ dpon slob mang po yod na skabs 'dir bai bsgrigs 'don sum cu rtsa grangs sam lnga bcu rtsa grangs sogs mdzad/ rdo rje phyir bsdams kyi mdzub mo gnyis kyi tshigs bar pa bkug nas mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse la sbyar ba rin po che'i phyag rgya bca'/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ḍa a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes pas rin po che'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par aḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams rgyas par 'bul ba ni/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ nyer spyod/ rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis brgyad la sogs pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rang bzhin stong nyid/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ rgya khyon nam mkha' gang ba/ byed las rgyal chen lhag par mnyes nas/ dngos grub kyi char chen po 'bebs par gyur cig thal mo kha stong snying khar bcas rim gyis bteg dpral bar bskor ba'i mthar s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pa dang mnyam du se gol gtogs/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya a brta ya ho/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i bsang gtor 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'khyil ba'i sngags dang / oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pā ri wā ra oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha tshigs bcad kyi bar thal mo sbyar oṃ bai sogs la pad kor prok+ṣa ṇaṃ sogs la bsang gtor sogs kyi phyag rgya pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

rnams la se gol byed/ pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i dod oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'di yin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur bas nyer spyod 'bul/ 'dir tshig 'ga' mi gsal ba'i bri ma thub/ spro na/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang / /gter chen bum pa pad+ma bzang / /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u dang / /mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa maṃ ga la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas bkra shis rdzas brgyad dbul/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che/ /dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang / /cang shes rta dang theg chen glang / /phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun rnams/ /bdag gi bsam pa yongs rdzogs phyir/ /rgyal chen sras dang btsun mor bcas/ /'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha sogs kyis rin chen bdun 'bul/ yid 'ong gzugs mdzes rnam pa dang / /rnar snyan rol mo'i rnam pa dang / /yid 'dzin dri dang phun tshogs kyi/ /ro mchog brgyad ldan zhal zas dang / /'jam mnyen 'khril chags na bza' ste/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga'i tshogs/ /rab 'byams zhing na gang yod rnams/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mtshan sngags kyi mthar pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pū dza sogs kyis 'dod yon dbul/ bsdus pa la dga' na/ de rnams kyi tshigs bcad dor de sngags tsam gyis dbul/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa bkra shis rdzas brgyad rin chen sna bdun 'dod yon sna lnga ste mchod pa 'di gsum gyis tshigs bcad la dril gsil/ oṃ bai sogs la pad kor aṣ+ṭa maṅga la sogs so so'i sngags la thal mo khang stong mthar se gol mdzad do pū dza sogs kyis 'dod yon dbul/ bsdus pa la dga' na/ de rnams kyi tshigs bcad dor te sngags tsam gyis dbul la/

de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rol mo brdung gdangs dang bcas pas/ sh+lau ka gcig la mgon po srin gzugs ma'i gdangs ring dang rol mo nyis brdeg lan can byed/ hūm̐ mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bso dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ skabs 'dir rol mo nyis brdeg lan can dang tshigs bcad phyi ma rnams la mgon po'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi dbyangs g.yang gzhi bla re'i 'dur gdangs rol mo gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang / /khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang / 'byor pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /gzhan don lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/ rgyal po'i thugs ka'i pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje ser po'i lte bar bai yig gser gyi mdog can snying po dang gzungs kyi phreng bas bskor ba dang / 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar yang zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'i mthar so so'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ rang gi lce rdo rjes mtshan pa bsam la/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ thugs ka'i sa bon dang / sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse la mchod pa sna tshogs spros te rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po spros te 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal 'byor/ gzi brjid/ longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas bdag gi snying gar thim par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phyag na rdo rje'i sngags ci rigs zhig sngon du bzlas la/

de nas rgyal po'i sngags bzla'o/ /gzungs 'di rnams bsgrigs 'don tshar gsum gsum mdzad/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ya hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba ar+tha me sā dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ su dha ne/ su ra ṇe/ su ma ti/ su pu ṣe/ hi li mi li swāhā/ snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swāhā/ zhes pa ste/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni bzhi 'bum mam/ rnam sras bskang gso'i tshe brgya rtsa gcig mdzad/ 'khor gyi sngags ni/ 'di man dpon slob mang po yod na sgrig 'don tshar gsum re thams cad la mdzad/ oṃ dzam+bha lā ya swāhā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swāhā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pra dzñā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ gu has+d+yā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ pāñtsi kā ya swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnam sras ser chen gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags dang / oṃ bh+rūṃ ṇi ā yu ṣe hūm̐/ zhes pa dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sngags dang / oṃ bai phu ta pa dro bi shwa ra bi dza ya swāhā/ zhes snying po/ oṃ bai shrā wa ṇā ye swāhā/ zhes nye snying ngo / /oṃ ma hā pad+ma ku la dha ri shaṅga ba su rat+na k+ṣa te nā ga sarba ma ni ma nu s+pha la swāhā/ zhes yum gyi snying po dang / oṃ ba su ko ṣa ba ra ma ni dh+rig ya ba su dha ri ni swāhā/ oṃ ba su bha dra purna bha dra saṃ bhu ta dzha bha wa/ kan+ta raṣa we te/ bha ba shwa na dha ra swāhā/ oṃ ad+ya a gu li a de ba li/ phu nā ga li/ ya yak+ṣa li/ ra rak+ṣa li/ ya ya ma li/ na maḥsarba sid+dhi ku ru swāhā/ rnam sras mthing ga yab yum gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags dang /

oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇā ye swāhā/ mgon po gar mkhan mchog gi sngags dang / na mo bai shrā ma ṇā ye nā tha ku be ra ma hā bha ga bh+yaḥkrita/ bha na bha na/ dh+yi ma na ba si ti swāhā/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma ku la dha ri shaṅga/ bha su rat+na k+ṣa te/ na ga sarba ma ṇi/ ma nu sma ra swāhā/ gar mkhan mchog dmar smug yab yum gyi sngags dang / oṃ ni laṃ bha ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma yak+ṣa rā dza ku be ra/ bi ru ra ga sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnam sras dregs byed seng zhon klu brgyad kyi sngags dang / oṃ ni laṃ bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza ku be ra/ bi ru ṭa ka sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnam sras dregs byed zhon pa spangs pa'i sngags dang / oṃ bai shrā ma ṇā tri pra ra pra ya hūm̐/ 'bar ba 'bar ba hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnam sras drag po yang gsang srin po bzhi bskor ba'i sngags dang / hūm̐ bai trag rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ rnam sras mthing nag bdud mo bzhi bskor gyi sngags dang / hūm̐ bai trag rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ rnam sras nang ma mo ltar sgrub pa lha dgu'i sngags dang / oṃ ma hā rā dza sa ma ya bai shrā ma ṇā ye sarba rat+na tsit+ta rat+na hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ rnam sras mdung dmar can phyag mtshon bzhi pa'i sngags dang / na mo bai shrā ma ṇā ye swā hā/ dha na da ya swā hā/ na mo ra tha pa ri pū ra ya swāhā/ rnam sras dmar po las mkhan mdung dmar bcas pa'i sngags dang / oṃ bai shrā ma ṇā ye hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ trag rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ rnam sras gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sngags dang / oṃ bai swāhā/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇā ye swāhā/ oṃ dzam+bha la ye swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra ye swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pra dzñā na ye swāhā/ oṃ gu h+ya na tha ye swāhā/ oṃ pañtsi ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swāhā/ rnam sras ljang yul ser chen lha dgu'i sngags dang /

oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ye swāhā/ rnam sras ljang ser be con can gyi sngags te/ gtso 'khor de rnams kyi sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇā sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta'i bar rigs 'gres sbyar te mchod la rol chen bya/ dril gsil gdangs ma lus sems can ma 'dur gdangs tal ma mdzad dang bcas pas/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bstod pa rgyal po'i thugs rab tu mnyes par byed pa zhes bya ba rnam sras bstod chen du grags pa'i nang nas byung ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul du bstan pa'i sgo nas bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang / /lha mi'i rgud pa ma lus bsal ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten skyong mdzad gnod sbyin chen por sprul/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi rgyal po khyod ni rnam snang mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs las sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ji bzhin mdzad do zhes/ /phyag na rdo rje yang dag shes la bshad/ /de phyir bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /mthu stobs thogs pa med pas bstan pa srung / /thugs rje chen pos bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong / /sangs rgyas rnam sprul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ 'khyil pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ bai shrā wa ṇā sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ grih+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes lnga'am bdun/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan tu/

ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya i daṃ bha liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pra dzñā na ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ gu h+ya thā na ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ pañtsi ka ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pas rta bdag brgyad dang / oṃ aṣ+ṭa ma hā nā ga ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pas klu chen brgyad/ oṃ ma hā se na pa ti aṣ+ṭa bing sha ta ye e daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan tu ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pas sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ oṃ ma hā ba la twa tiṃ ṣa ṭa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pas stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams la phul/ bsdu na thams cad la/ a kā ros phul kyang chog par bshad pa rnam thos sras kyi rigs gtso 'khor ji snyed pa thams cad la phul bar bsam ste/ gtor sngags sgrigs 'don rnams grub pa dang sgrigs 'don med par a kā ro nyer gcig tsam gyis rnam sras kyi rigs thams cad la 'bul bar mdzad/ a kā ro'i sngags lan nyer gcig tsam brjod la de nas rol mo dkar dung nas 'dra gsum dang chems brdung gis bcom la/

gsum brdeg len can byas la/ rnga brdung dbyangs dang bcas pas/ 'di la tshigs bcad gcig la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang / gzhan rnams la 'dur gdangs mdzad/ hūm̐ rin chen pho brang dam pa nas/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng nas/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bso dge ba stobs po che/ /sems pa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od las mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /sku la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras zhes mtshan yang grags/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol/ /yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sde dpon che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa bzang po rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /rdzing bu zab mo 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzaṃ bha la ni gser gyi mdog /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /rin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon naྎ /bum paྎ /nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon naྎ /nor buྎ /ku be ra ni sku mdog nag /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon naྎ /ral griྎ /yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrulྎ /g.yon naྎ /gser khriྎ /'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la/ /rdzu 'phrulྎ /g.yon naྎ /mdung dmarྎ /lnga rtsen sku mdog ser skya la/ /rdzu 'phrulྎ /g.yon naྎ /khang brtsegsྎ /pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni dkar/ /rdzu 'phrulྎ /g.yon naྎ /gri phubྎ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/

/mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs ste/ /g.yon pa thams cad ne'u le/ /g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po 'khor bcas khyod rnams kyis/ /khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud/ /khyod ni gter bdag chen po ste/ /nor bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di la gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ ces pas bstod/ 'di la 'dur gdangs dang mjug tu gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ hūm̐ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gtor ma 'bul ba de dag bzhes nas kyang / /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /bu sdug bzhin du skyong bar mdzad du gsol/ /skabs 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ bdag 'di la yang 'dur gdangs mdzad/ la gnod par bsam pa yi/ /log par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams/ /de yi sgyu ma gzhom pa dang / /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul cher mnga' ba'i/ /gnod sbyin bdag po khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa/ /myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas 'phrin las gzhol/ de nas skabs 'dir bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i bstod chen gyi bshags pa'i le'u nas 'byung ba'i tshig lhug pa'i bshags pa 'di bzhin dpon slob rnams kyis bsgrigs 'don dang bcas rten rnams la me tog 'thor bzhin pa'i ngang nas bya ste/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang / de'i sras dang btsun mor bcas pa dang / blon po chen po rta bdag brgyad dang / sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / ljangs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang yul 'khor skyong ba'i gnod sbyin 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis nyan thos kyi theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa thams cad nyan thos chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/

/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba thams cad byang chub sems dpa' chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /khyad par du'ang rgyal po chen po khyed la bka' sdod du gsol zhing skyabs su song nas/ khyed kyi bka' dang dam tshig las 'das te/ spyi'i dam tshig gsum ma bsrung ba dang / khyad par gyi dam tshig bzhi dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / 'jig rten ngo bsrung gi dbang gis snod ma yin pa la chos bstan pa dang / khyad par rgyal po'i bka' lung sbyin mi 'os pa la byin pa dang / rang 'dod kyi dbang gis phrin las zhu bar mi 'os pa la zhus pa dang / le lo'i dbang gis bzlas sgom chag pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa dang gtor ma chag cing ngan pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang 'grogs pa la sogs rgyal po chen po'i thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /dmigs med chos sku'i ngang du bzod par bzhes nas bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spros pa mi mnga' chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ /snyan bsrings mi mnga' kun tu gsan pa'i snyan/ /sgrib pa mi mnga' thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /thog med dus nas nyon mongs las dbang gis/ /bag med stobs kyis nyes pa gang bgyis pa/ /skye med chos sku'i ngang du so sor bshags/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bur dag gyur cig /khyad par khyed kyi dam tshig las 'das te/ /bag med 'chol pas thugs dam ma bskongs pa/ /bde chen longs sku'i gnas su so sor bshags/ /mkha' la na bun yal ba ltar gyur cig /dam nyams tshogs 'dres 'chol bar spyod dang 'grogs/

/dman nyams grib mas phog pa'i nyes pa gang / /cir snang sprul sku'i ngang du so sor bshags/ /bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin zhi gyur cig /ces pa lan gcig gam gsum la sogs pa bya/ de yan chad ni gtor bsngo'o/ /de nas gtor ma bsang sbyangs sogs pa bskang rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo gzhan gsum bskyangs pas kha sbyar la/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe dharma te badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐/ ('dir yig chung kha shas ma gsal)thal mo gnyis bkan nas snyim pa sbyar te/ rin po che rin chen sgrom bu dpral bar byas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥnas/ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes bsangs/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo rnams bsnol ba'i gung mo gnyis rtse sprad la/ tshigs bar pa bcags la dpral bar sbyar te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang / g.yas pa'i thal mo gan rkyal du brkyangs pas pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ a kā ro nas/ na twata ces pa dang / g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgrengs rdzas la gtad la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa dang / g.yas pa'i thal mo snying ga'i thad du kha phyir bstan la bslangs la/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+thā sa dha ne swāhā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ sngags dang phyag rgya de dag re re'i mthar se gol brdab te/ thams cad la lan gsum gsum bya zhing de rnams kyi g.yon pas pang du khu tshur byas la bzhag go /de nas/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces sogs brjod/ bskyed chog dang spyan 'dren ni gtor bsngo'i des 'thus par thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub bzhed pas de ltar byin gyis brlabs tshar ba'i gtor ma de rnam sras ser can 'khor bcas la rgyas par na gtor bsngo'i skabs bzhin 'bul/

bsdu na/ rnam sras gtso bo la gong bzhin dang / rta bdag brgyad sogs 'khor rnams la/ a mṛ taྎ oṃ dzaṃ bha la ye/ oṃ pūrna bha dra ye/ ma ṇi bha dra ye/ ku be ra ye/ saṃ pra dzñā na ye/ gu h+ya ha thā ye/ pañtsi ka ye/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye sa pa ri wā ra nas/ sa dha a mo gha ye swāhā/ a mṛ taྎ oṃ aṣ+ṭha nā ga sha ta sa hā pra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rak+sha sa pa ri wā ra nas/ a mo gha ye swāhā gsum/ rnams kyis mchod gtor mchod/ a kā ros bsngo chog mthar 'jam mgon a mes zhabs bzhed pas de bzhin nam rgyas par na so so'i gtor sngags kyis bsngo/ dkar dung nas 'dra gsum dang bcas de nas rol mo bcom la sum brdeg lan can bya zhing / rnga brdung 'dur dbyangs dang bcas/ bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa'i le'u 'di nyid bya ste/ mgon po 'di'i tshigs bcad dang po gsum dang / de nas tshigs bcad bzhi dang / de nas tshigs bcad lnga rnams la mgon po'i chos nyid ma'i mchod dbyangs bcug nas mtshams rnams su rol mo gsum brdeg lan can re mdzad/ gnas srung 'khor bcas la/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin las byung ba'i/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos/ /mar me dri bzang zhal zas mchog /zag med bde skyed nyer spyod rnams/ /'jig rten mtha' dag bkang nas 'bul/ /pi wang gling bu zangs dung dang / /dung dang rdza rnga rnga bo che/ /rol mo'i khyad par stong phrag bcu/ /snyan pa'i sgra yis rab tu mchod/ /dge ba'i stobs las 'khrungs pa yi/ /dpag bsam shing las byung gyur pa/ /lha rdzas yo byad ma lus rnams/ /blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi/ /rol mo/ mi dbang bsod nams mthu las byung / /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun/ /rgyal po 'gren zla mi byed pa'ang / /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /lha mi'i dpal ni 'phel byed cing / /don kun 'grub par byed pa'i rdzas/

/gdugs sogs bkra shis brgyad po yang / /gnas srung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /gya nom phul byung 'jig rten khams/ /bkang nas gnas srung 'khor bcas kyi/ /dbang po lnga rnams tshim phyir 'bul/ /ral gri la sogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /mkha' spyod la sogs dngos grub ster/ /grub pa nyi shu rtsa bdun yang / /rgyal chen thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir 'bul/ rol mo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /gsang sngags rig sngags mthu stobs dang / /chos dbyings rnam dag byin rlabs kyis/ /gtor ma 'di ni lha rdzas kyi/ /bdud rtsi la sogs longs spyod tshogs/ /zag med bde ba bskyed nus pa/ /ngal bso 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /nam mkha' gang bar 'byung gyur cig /khyed la bkres skom mi mnga' yang / /zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i rgyur/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag don slad du/ /dmigs med tshul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /lha min g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i/ /nor bu'i tog 'bar ba dan g.yo/ /rgyal mtshan 'di 'bul bdud dpung gi /dgra las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ /skabs 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ rin 'di'i tshigs bcad gcig la phur pa'i sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/ chen bdun las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / /bkod legs dbyibs mdzes sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /lcang lo can mtshungs sprul pa'i khang brtsegs 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas su 'bul/ /phyi nang dar 'di la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung zab bar du srin bal can/ /gong thong stod chod rab mdzes rin chen gyi/ /srad bus zung btab sham kris sub mas bskor/ /ber chen bzang 'di rgyal po'i na rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bza' 'bul/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar sngo zhing mdzes/ /nyi zla lta bu'i mig 'bur mtho la rgyas/ /phuṃ phuṃ yid 'ong char sprin lta bur gtibs/

/na bun lta bu'i ze rngog rab gzhol zhing / /char chu'i rgyun ltar rnga ma'i rgyun ring la/ /bar snang lta bur rkang lag khong yangs shing / /glog 'phreng lta bur rmig bzhi rab 'khyug pa/ /cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang lta bu'i rta/ /glang po'i dbang po lta bur nyams stobs ldan/ /mkha' lding lta bur rtsol med goms pa'i shugs/ /rtsol bas chung 'bring rab tu cher bgrod pa'i/ /'gros par 'gams dang bang gis myur bar bgrod/ /mgyogs tshad 'gro ba mi mngon lta bur ldan/ /rta mchog rin chen lta bu 'di dang ni/ /dkar ser dmar dang mtsha' lu zhur po dang / /ngang pa 'ol ba la sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /rta mchog gser gyi g.yer khas mgrin par spras/ /srab 'jam yang la mdzes pa'i sha stan dang / /ar mo li ga'i thags la stan du bsdad/ /rin chen shel la gser gyis spras pa'i sga/ /gser la dngul gyisabasdams pa'i sga glegs can/ /rin chen kar ke ta na'i yob gtan la/ /iṇ+ḍa nī la'i yob chen mdzes pa can/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'breng dmar mdzes pa la/ /rin chen margad rgyun gyi shar bus btab/ /gong thag rmed chen rmed chung rab sgeg cing / /bai ḍūr+ya yi glo thag mdzes pa 'di/ /rdo rje pha lam pho long dam pos bsdams/ /rin chen bdun gyis kun nas spud pa yi/ /srab mgo kha lo bsgyur ba'i srab skyogs dang / /mu tig 'bur gyis bsdams pa'i mthur mgo bcings/ /lha rdzas dar gyis byas pa'i mthur mda' dang / /myur du skul byed shel gyis lcag 'bras can/ /rta mchog rgyan dang chas kyis spras 'di rnams/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /mgon po bzhon pas phongs pa mi mnga' yang / /bdag sogs bstan 'dzin rnams kyi don slad bzhes/ /phyogs bcur 'phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub tu gsol/ /bsod nams stobs las grub pa'i 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /yid la ci bsam nus ma las byung ba/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong don kun 'grub pa 'di/

/rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /de 'di la rol mo gsum brdeg lan can dang / yang sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang bcas/ bzhin yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /bum bzang ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog dang / /khrus rdzing sman ljongs skyed mos tshal la sogs/ /mchod rdzas yid 'ong thams cad dbul bar bgyi/ /rmig bzhi rab brtan rwa ni rno la ring / /rtsid pa'i zhol ring rnga ma kun tu g.yo/ /dar gyi phud bus mdzes par brgyan pa yi/ /zhol chen g.yag 'di khyed la 'bul bar bgyi/ /dkar la 'jam pa'i spu yi gos gyon zhing / /'khyil ba'i rwa la chu ris mdzes pas brgyan/ /gnas can rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa'i/ /lug gi khyu 'di khyed kyi 'brog tu 'bul/ /gangs yang rol mo sngar bzhin gdangs dang bcas pa/ ri ltar dkar bcu drug gling can rmog /sra mdzes byang bu rin chen rgyun gyis sbrel/ /sra brtan spab dang bcas pa'i khrab 'di dang / /phub zhol spang lan bcas pa'i go 'di 'bul/ /rin chen rgyu la mkhas pas rab sbyangs shing / /rno ngar can dang ldan pa'i ral gri 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /bstan pa'i dgra rnams gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol/ /gser dngul gos dar ja ras stag gzig dang / /snam bu sha mar ka ra bu ram sogs/ /spyan gzigs yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyang / /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /mgon po khyod la phongs pa mi mnga' yang / /bdag sogs sems can rnams kyi don slad du/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i 'dod don sgrub pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces brjod cing rol mo sum brdeg lan can bya/ 'di'i mtshams su 'phrin 'chol sa skya'i rje btsun ma'i dbyangs rol dkyus bzhin mdzad/ de nas zhwa gyon cing bstod chen nas byung ba'i 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshig 'di rnams brjod/ gang thugs 'dur gdangs dang bcas/

sgrib gnyis las grol zhing / /ji lta ji snyed kun mkhyen nas/ /thugs rje chen po'i gnod sbyin gyi/ /skur sprul rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /btsun mo sras kyi tshogs dang bcas/ /khyad par gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad/ /sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /stobs po che ni sum cu gnyis/ /ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / /yul 'khor bsrung ba lnga brgya dang / /'phrog ma bu bcas srin mo bdun/ /ma mo brgyad dang klu brgyad dang / /sna tshogs gzugs can gnod sbyin dang / /srin po sha za pho nya dang / /bran dang g.yog tu bcas pa kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /khyod sngon ston pa'i spyan snga ru/ /dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi/ /bsrung zhing skyob par zhal bzhes shing / /dam bca' brtan po gang mdzad pa/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' dgongs mdzad nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi/ /dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa dang / /bstan pa mchod pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /las dang nyon mongs sdig pa kun/ /nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngon gyi las sam 'phral rkyen las/ /gyur pa'i 'jigs dang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /sdang byed dgra yi dmag tshogs dang / /chom rkun gdol pas gtses pa dang / /lus srog nor la gnod byed pa'i/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims/ /bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon chen rnams/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /glo bur ye 'drog gnod pa dang / /byad stims mthu dang 'byung ba 'khrugs/ /mi dang mi min gnod pa rnams/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /phyi nang lus sems sdug bsngal kun/ /rang gi las byung mod na 'ang / /dbang bcu brnyes pa khyod kyi mthus/ /bde ba'i las 'bras gsos btab cing / /sdug bsngal las 'bras zil mnan te/ /bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /lus sems sdug bsngal kun skyob cing /

/las nyon zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyod sngon ston pa'i spyan snga ru/ /sems can dbul phongs sel ba dang / /tshe srog rgud pa las bskyabs shing / /bu sdug bzhin du skyong ngo zhes/ /dam bcas gang yin de dgongs la/ /bdag cag dpon slob grogs mched sogs/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /skabs 'dir rol mo sum brdeg lan can byed/ dus min 'chi ba'i dgra las rnam rgyal te/ /lus stobs kha dog zo mdog rab rgyas shing / /dam chos spyod pa'i lus ni ring du 'tsho/ /tshe la gnod med rab tu rgyas par mdzod/ /khyod ni nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas/ bdag sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /log 'tsho med cing chos dang mthun pa yi/ /longs spyod 'byor pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'gro ba kun gyi phan bde'i rgyur gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen sgron me 'di/ /nag phyogs bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gyur bar/ /rgyun du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag thams cad kyang / /chos min spangs shing dge ba'i blo gros rgyas/ /chos mthun 'khor dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /bshad sgrub chos kyi bya ba rgyas par mdzod/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams thams cad kyang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams kun spangs nas/ /dge ba'i longs spyod thams cad phun tshogs shing / /bde skyid dpal 'byor kun nas rgyas par mdzod/ /khyod sngon rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gang su rgyal chen dkyil 'khor zhugs pa de/ /rgyal po ma yin rgyal por 'gyur ba dang / /yin na chen por 'gyur phyir brtson bya zhes/ /thugs dam dam bcas gang yin de dgongs la/ /bdag sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa'i bya ba yun du sgrub pa'i phyir/ /thams cad chos kyi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje ldan pa yis/

/bstan pa 'dzin nus gang zag thams cad kyang / /zab rgyas chos kyi snod du rung ba'i phyir/ /chos bzhin dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /dad pa dman zhing dge ba'i blo gros dman/ /chos lam 'jug pa'i skal ba chung ba rnams/ /rgyal chen chos kyi lam la sbyar ba'i phyir/ /thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /ma dang mi bsrun gtum po'i las byed cing / /rnam pa kun tu 'gro la gnod pa byed/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig byed de rnams kyi/ /ma rungs gdug pa'i sems ni rab bcom nas/ /bstan dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag la/ /dad cing gus pa'i dbang gis 'dud gyur te/ /chos min spangs shing chos dang mthun pa yi/ /bya ba kun la sbyar bar mdzad du gsol/ /gnod sems can gyi mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gnod sems spangs shing dge ba'i sems dang ldan/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bdag gis ci bsgo ba/ /nyan cing bsgrub phyir dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /rdo rje 'chang chen phyag na rdo rje dang / /spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'gro bzang snying po rin chen rdo rje dang / /kha che dgon pa zangs dkar lo tsā dang / /g.yor po jo ston bsod nams rin chen dang / /pad+ma bkra shis stag pa jo bzang dang / /byams pa lo tsā bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /bsod nams seng ge rin chen seng ge ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma de rnams kyi/ /brten brten bsgrubs bsgrubs gsol gsol mchod mchod pa/ /bka' dang dam la btags pa'i dam tshig can/ /chos mdzad bu bzhin skyong ba'i thugs rje can/ /chos skyong chen po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gces par bsrung ba dang / /nag phyogs rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /'di yan bskang ba dang zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin bcol yin/ sngon 'dir gdangs dang bcas pa'am yang na mgon po'i bskang gso chos nyid ma'i bzlog pa'i mgo'i rol mo blangs la/

tshigs bcad gnyis la chos nyid ma'i bzlog pa'i gdangs 'jug par mdzad/ tshe ston pa'i zhal snga nas/ /lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i rkyen byung tshe/ /gcig tu bsdongs la srungs shig ces/ /zhes pa 'di nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal stong par mdzod bar drag po'i bskul yin pas 'di rgyun du ma btang na legs pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung las 'on kyang drag po'i 'phrin las kyi bskul ni rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob pas drag po'i gtor ma dang 'brel ba'i tshe ma gtogs rang la chos skyong bgo ba'i ched du sgrub pa yin na ma byas pa legs pa mkhas pa rnams bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ ༈ /zhal skong ni/ bsod nams seṅge rin chen seṅge dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha'i mtshan can dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen dpal grub dang / /rdo rje 'chang dngos mkhyen rab chos rje dang / /kun spang chos rje tshar chen rdo rje 'chang / /mkhyen brtse dbang phyug bar du byon pa dang / /dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag zhwa lu ba/ /bsod nams mchog grub rin chen 'jam dpal dang / /drag rtsal rje dang sa chen kun blo'i zhabs/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan snga rigs kun bkras dang / /yab rje pad 'dul skal bzang chos nyid dang / /shes rab phun tshogs 'dren mchog kun snying sogs/ bka' bsgos khyod kyis khas blangs shing / /gzhan yang mdo rgyud 'dzin pa dang / /gnas pa'i gang zag gnas dang bcas/ /bsrung ba'i dam bcas dgongs par mdzod/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'di ni/ /mi rnams chos min spyod pa'i rgyus/ /mu ge yams nad lo nyes dang / /choms rkun 'khrug pa dar bar 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rten 'joms shing / /dge 'dun 'dul ba'i sgo rnams 'phrog /dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa 'joms/ /sems can mang po'i srog 'phrog cing /

/chos pa rnams ni lhag par gtses/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra la/ /khyod kyis bsrung skyobs mi mdzad na/ /thugs rje chen po mi mnga' yang / /mi dang mi min bdud dpung gis/ /'gro ba nyams thag byas pa dang / /bstan la gnod byed 'di 'dra ba/ /ye shes spyan gyis ma gzigs sam/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal smre sngags dang / /bstan 'dzin nyams thag nga ro yis/ /'o dod phyogs bcur 'bod pa 'di/ /sgrib med snyan gyis ma gsan nam/ /thogs med gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa dang / /thugs rje skyobs pa'i mthu yod bzhin/ /sdug bsngal gnod pa 'di 'dra la/ /gzigs na yal bar 'dor ram ci/ /thams cad las la rag las pas/ /sems can las dbang spyod dka' na/ /las min thog tu mi babs pas/ /thugs rjes bsrung skyob ci zhig 'tshal/ /'di 'dra'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ /sems can sdug bsngal mi skyob cing / /bstan pa gces par mi bsrung na/ /sngon gyi dam bca' bsnyel lam ci/ /de bas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gnod byed 'byung po gdon gyi tshogs/ /zhi bas mi thul ma rungs pa/ /drag pos tshar bcad dus la babs/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /sdig pa'i las las bzlog pa'i phyir/ /thugs rjes khros pa'i thabs kyis ni/ /drag pos tshar bcad dus la babs/ /de bas rgyal po chen po khyod/ /sras dang bcas shing blon por bcas/ /dmag dpon sde dang bcas rnams kyis/ /nag phyogs bdud dpung 'di choms shig /rgyal chen shing rta bcas pa na/ /lha mi'i yul du sgra chen grags/ /rgyal chen lam du chas pa na/ /dngos po thams cad 'bar bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i lha dang dri za dang / /sa steng gnod sbyin srin po dang / /sa 'og klu dang lha min gyi/ /dmag tshogs 'jigs pas shin tu gang / /srin po 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs/ /de yi mdun na rab tu rgyug /mi ma yin pa'i gzugs rnams kyis/ /'jigs shing skrag pa skyed byed pa/

/sna tshogs gzugs can mi sdug pa/ /ri rab rtse mo sgul bar byed/ /me mdag char pa 'bebs par byed/ /zas su sha dang khrag za zhing / /las su gdug pa'i srog 'phrog byed/ /khyod la mthu dang rtsal yod kyis/ /nag phyogs bdud kyi dpung 'di rnams/ /rtsad nas gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyod ni thugs rjes khros pa'i tshe/ /sku stod ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /mkha' lding bya khra 'ug pa dang / /kang ka la sogs bya gcan spro/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i gdug pa can/ /thams cad bkug nas sa la phob/ /rgyu lto dral nas don snying phyungs/ /don snying dbang po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /gnod sbyin mang po'i zhal du stob/ /sha khrag rkang rus ma lus par/ /bya gcan pho nyas rngam par gsol/ /sku sked ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /gnod sbyin srin po mi sdug gzugs/ /mgo brnyan sna tshogs lag pa na/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa spros/ /sa steng rgyu ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bstan pa 'jig par byed pa rnams/ /lcags kyus snying nas drangs nas ni/ /mgrin pa zhags pas chings la khug /yan lag mtshon chas dum bur gtubs/ /rgyu ma nang khrol thang la phob/ /don snying 'jigs byed zhal du stob/ /sha khrag gnod sbyin tshogs rnams rol/ /sku smad ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /seng ge stag dang dom dang dred/ /sha ra bha sogs gcan gzan tshogs/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can dpag med spros/ /sa 'og rgyu ba'i gdug pa can/ /sa yi gting nas steng du drongs/ /pho nya gcan gzan tshogs rnams kyis/ /sha rus lhag ma med par rol/ /khyed kyi sras po stobs po che/ /dbang po zhes bya dgu bcu gcig /stobs dang rdzu 'phrul cher ldan rnams/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /khyed kyi khyad par sras bzhi po/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu yi/ /dmag sde dang bcas stobs ldan rnams/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /khyed kyi phul du byung ba'i sras/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor kyis bskor/

/sde che dpung che mthu che ba/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /gnod sbyin dbang po gar mkhan mchog /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /blon po chen po rta bdag brgyad/ /sde dpon nyer brgyad stobs po che/ /so gnyis re re'ang bye ba yi/ /sde dang bcas shing g.yog dang bcas/ /ljangs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / /yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya yang / /sde dang bcas shing dpung dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /srin mo che bdun bu dang bcas/ /ma mo brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /sde dang bcas shing g.yog dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /bstan pa'i dgra dpung gzhom pa'i phyir/ /lus la sra ba'i go cha gyon/ /phyag tu rno ba'i mtshon cha thogs/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /'jigs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur gyes/ /bstan pa bshegs pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang / /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /sde dang bcas shing dpung dang bcas/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes tshar bcad nas/ /kun nas kun tu gzhom par mdzod/ /ngan sems 'dun gros nang nas shig /sra ba'i go cha lus las phrol/ /'debs pa'i mtshon cha rdul du shig /skyob pa'i lha dang bral bar gyis/ /grogs byed mdza' ba'i bshes dang phrol/ /bar 'di jo rdzong dpal 'byor gyi bstod chen bar ma na/ gdug pa'i sems dang lus po phrol/ / zhes pa zhig snang / las nyon ye shes me yis sregs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal stongs par mdzad/ /ces brjod cing rol mo chems brdung dkar dung drag tu 'bud/ dang bcas drag rol so so'i las kyi dmigs pa rgyas pa bsgoms shing / de nas rol mo sum brdeg lan can byas la/ rnga brdung dbyangs dang bcas pas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i thog mar rgyal po'i gnas la bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/

gang thugs 'di la mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma thung ba tshigs bcad gcig la 'jug par mdzad/ gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /nyon mongs gdug pa sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul/ /thugs rjes rab khros khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstan 'di man la 'dur gdangs mdzad pa srung ba dam bcas zhal bzhes shing / /'jig rten skyong mdzad grags mthu rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /gnas gsum khyod kyi yon tan cha tsam zhig /bdag gis rab tu dad pas brjod par bgyi/ /gnod sbyin dbang po'i pho brang lcang lo can/ /lha rnams kun gyi yid kyi bris pa bzhin/ /phyi ra mthon po dpag tshad bcu drug dpang / /ngos rer dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu ste/ /gser gyi rgyu la rin chen kun gyis spras/ /phyogs bzhi'i lcogs ni re re dag la yang / /gnod sbyin rdo rje 'chang ba rab tu gnas/ /pho brang de la sgo bzhi gtod pa ni/ /byang ni gser la dngul gyis spras pa'i sgo/ /shar ni dngul la gser gyis spras pa'i sgo/ /lho ni gser gyis spras pa'i bai ḍūr+ya/ /nub ni shel la bai ḍūr+ya yis spras/ /grong khyer nang na me tog rab rgyas pa'i/ /skyed tshal rin chen sna tshogs ljon shing can/ /bya bran sna tshogs snyan pa'i sgra 'byin la/ /sna tshogs spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /lam srang gser gyi rang bzhin g.yas g.yon du/ /sbrang rtsi'i chus gang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan/ /spu sdug gos gyon chu bya skad snyan sgrog /gnod sbyin mo rnams rab tu 'jo sgeg pas/ /klu dang rol mo sna tshogs byed pas brgyan/ /de yi nang na gzhal med khang mdzes pa/ /rin chen bdun du sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /sgo dang rta babs rin chen them skas dang / /rin chen snam bu drwa ba drwa phyed dang / /shar bu mda' yab la sogs rgyan rnams kun/ /rin chen du mas grub cing shin tu mdzes/

/de yi dbus na chos kyi rgyal po gnas/ /bsil ba'i rdzing bu sbrang rtsi lta bu'i chus/ /gang zhing bya dang me tog mdzes pas brgyan/ /dri bsung ldan pa'i tsan+dan nags kyis bskor/ /pho brang kun nas dpag tshad drug cu pa/ /brtsegs ma dang po rin chen gser las grub/ /gnyis pa dngul dang gsum pa bai ḍūr+ya/ /bzhi pa gtsang dwangs shel gyi rgyu las byung / /lnga pa mu tig dmar po drug pa ni/ /rdo yi snying po bdun pa spug las bgyis/ /brgyad pa rin chen bdun las grub pa la/ /rtse mo nyi zla nor bu'i tog gis spras/ /rin chen bzhi las grub pa'i ka ba ni/ /brgyad khri'i ka gdan ka zhu khyams gdung sogs/ /sna tshogs rin chen spras pa'i rab mdzes pa/ /lha yi bud med stong phrag brgya dag kyang / /khang brtsegs re rer gnas shing rtsed 'jo byed/ /lha rdzas lhab lhub sna tshogs mchog dag ni/ /bla re la sogs cha byad sna tshogs dang / /glu dang rol mo lha rdzas bdud rtsi yi/ /bza' btung 'dod yon sna tshogs 'byor ba yi/ /yon tan gzhal du med pa'i khang brtsegs mchog /sna tshogs bkod pa dus mas rab mdzes pa/ /lha gnas bye bas bskrun par mi nus pa'i/ /pho brang mchog tu bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas byung ba'i rgyal po gtso bo la bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ sprin 'di la tshigs bcad gcig la mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo ring ba dang bcas pa mdzad/ med mkha' la nam mkha'i nor bu gzis/ /zla skar 'od rnams zil gyis gnon pa bzhin/ /khyod sku yon tan rgyas pa gser gyi mdog /gzi 'od 'bar bas lha min zil gyis gnon/ /'gro 'di man la 'dur gdangs mdzad/ ba kun la dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i tog gis rab mdzes pa'i/ /'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog

/g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen pos phongs pa kun skyob phyir/ /dgos 'dod sgrub byed nor bu sna tshogs pa/ /kha nas 'byin pa'i ne'u le g.yon pas 'dzin/ /ser sna spong pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /'gro ba kun gyi re 'dod skong ba'i phyir/ /zhal nas sna tshogs nor gyi char pa 'bebs/ /sbyin pa mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba nya ltar tshogs gnyis bzhin ras rgyas/ /pad dkar rgyas 'dra'i mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /pad+ma'i tshal du nyi zer lhung ba ltar/ /'dzum zhal dges pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shes mun sel nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /thabs shes nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa/ /khyod kyi phrag gong g.yas g.yon mdzes par brgyan/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi rgyal po chen por dbang bskur ba'i/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan prog zhu gsol/ /bdud las rnam rgyal dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs mdzes/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyan gong ut+pal mdzes pa'i me tog can/ /snyan shel lha rdzas las grub 'khyil pas brgyan/ /rin chen mgul rgyan mdzes pa'i se mo do/ /nor bu'i do shal 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po'i phyag dang zhabs la lha rdzas kyi/ /gdu bu rgyan cha sna tshogs 'phra bkod pa/ /ska rags 'og pag nor bu'i tshar tshar bcing / /g.yer kha'i drwa bas spras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzi brjid mtshungs med skus/ /nyi zla bye ba'i gzi yang zil gnon cing / /yon tan rgyas pa'i na bza' ser khra yis/ /lhab lhub brjid pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni 'jigs med gdong lnga'i gdan steng na/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung rab tu brjid pas 'gyings/ /srid gsum mnga' mdzad gzi brjid mtha' yas sku/ /yon tan rab rdzogs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyed gsung yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhir ldan/

/brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la dbang bsgyur zhing / /khyod kyi sngags kyis las nyon sgrib pa 'joms/ /'dod dgu sbyin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod thugs gnyis med ye shes me dpung gis/ /lta ba ngan pa'i tshang tshing kun sreg cing / /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gtan nas skems mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes rgyas pa'i thugs pa phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di yan mdzad/ 'dur gdangs mdzod/ lha chen mang du thos pa'i drang srong gi /spyod pas dka' thub mdzad cing gnas pa'i tshe/ /de dang lha mo dpal las khyed 'khrungs te/ /mtshan yang srid sgrub btags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha rnams kyis/ /srid gsum rgyal por dbang bskur lcang lo can/ /phul nas rnam mang thos pa'i sras zhes bstod/ /rnam thos sras su grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha min sgra gcan lha la 'thab pa'i tshe/ /khyed sku ri rab sked par ngal gso ba'i/ /gzi brjid ma bzod ngal gsor phyag 'tshal zhes/ /bstod pas ngal gsos grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgul phreng dmag gis lha gnas phrogs pa'i tshe/ /khyed sku gser gyi go bgos seng ge zhon/ /lha gnas bsrungs pas gnas srung phyag 'tshal zhes/ /bstod pas gnas srung grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab rgod dmag gis lha gnas phrogs pa'i tshe/ /khyed sku sngon po'i gzi brjid ma bzod par/ /lus ngan 'di 'dras bdag cag btul lo zhes/ /bstod pas lus ngan grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar/ /phyag g.yas rin chen be con rab tu 'phyar/ /g.yon pa rin chen skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'jigs seng ge pad+ma zla gdan la/ /brjid mdzes 'gyings pas bzhengs pa'i tshul du mdzad/ /rin chen dbu rgyan la sogs rgyan rnams kyis/ /mdzes par brgyan pa khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi g.yon du las mkhan mdung dmar can/

/mdog dmar bse rmog bse khrab lus la gsol/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar shel gyi mchod rten g.yon/ /srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dbul phongs sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /sku mdog ljang ser zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /za 'og ber gsol dar mtshon 'gying thod bcings/ /rin chen rgyan spras ral gri rgyal mtshan g.yas/ /g.yon pas par bu rin chen ne'u le 'dzin/ /rgyan chas spras pa'i ngang pa gser ldan chibs/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /zhi bar mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ khyod 'dur gdangs mdzad/ ni gdug pa tshar gcod phyir/ /thugs rje chen po rab khros pas/ /mthing nag gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sku/ /rab gtum khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas rdo rjes rab mtshan pa'i/ /dbyug pa ba dan bcas pa 'phyar/ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus rnams/ /'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon pas yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i/ /chos sku mchod rten thugs khar 'dzin/ /bde gshegs bstan pa gces pa ru/ /srung mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /rgya mtsho 'khrugs cing lha min skrag /ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ sgra brjod pas/ /gnam lcags 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mche ba gtsigs pas gdug pa 'dul/ /spyan 'gyur skar mda' stong phrag ltung / /smin ma bskyod pas glog phreng 'khyug /khro gnyer bsdus la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i gzis/ /srid gsum 'od kyis snang byed cing / /nag phyogs bdud kyi mun pa kun/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa'i klu brgyad lus la brgyan/ /gdug pa'i kha rlangs rab 'phros pas/ /gdug pa can gyi srog 'phrog byed/ /gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku stod ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /mkha' lding bya gcan pho nya 'gyed/ /sa bla'i gdug pa ma lus pa/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sku sked ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /gnod sbyin srin po pho nya 'gyed/ /sa steng gdug pa ma lus pa/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku smad ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /stag sogs gcan gzan pho nya 'gyed/ /sa 'og gdug pa ma lus pa/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas byung ba'i sras la bstod pa'i le'u dbu nas sh+lau ka gnyis kyi bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ gnod 'di skabs tshigs bcad gnyis la skabs su gur drag gi nga ni ye nas sogs mtshams gcod kyi dbyangs 'khor gnyis rol mo dang bcas pa bcug pa'i mgo mjug gi rol mo chems brdung gnyis dor ba mdzad/ rgyun par phal cher 'dur gdangs mdzad/ sbyin dbang po khyod kyi sras/ /mthu mang stobs ldan dgu bcu gcig /khyad par sde chen ldan pa bzhi/ /phul byung 'phrin las 'grub pa gsum/ /bla med mchog tu gyur pa cig /mthu che dpung che rdzu 'phrul che/ /yon tan dpag med ldan pa yi/ /sras kyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i 'khor la bstod pa'i le'u'i nang nas klu chen yan gyi bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ gsang 'dur gdangs mdzad/ ba'i bdag po khyod kyi 'khor/ /khyad par blon chen rta bdag brgyad/ /phyogs skyong sde dpon nyi shu brgyad/ /chos spun stobs chen sum cu gnyis/ /nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / /yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya dang / 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / /srin mo che bdun bu 'khor bcas/ /ma mo chen mo brgyad po dang / /sna tshogs gzugs can srin mo dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin dbang po rmug 'dzin ni/ /gser mdog phyag g.yas rin chen 'dzin/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa/ /shar phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/

/gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /ci dgos nang nas 'byung ba yi/ /bum pa bzang po g.yas pas 'dzin/ /lho phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu bzang po zla rgyas mdog /phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /'gro ba'i re ba rdzogs mdzad pa/ /nub phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta bdag chen po ku be ra/ /mthing nag khros pa ral gri 'dzin/ /dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa/ /byang phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid shes pa'i yang dag shes/ /shes rab gser gyi ral gri 'dzin/ /mi shes gcod pa sku mdog ser/ /me mtshams gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brog gnas rab tu khros shing gnag /lha min bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa'i/ /mdung rnon mtshon cha g.yas pas 'dzin/ /bden bral gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyin mtshan cho lo lnga rtse ba'i/ /lnga rtsen ser skya rgyas pa yi/ /rigs bdag g.yas na khang brtsegs bsnams/ /rlung mtshams gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam po 'khyil pa dung gi mdog /shes rab go chas gzhan 'joms shing / /rang srung gri phub g.yas pas 'dzin/ /dbang ldan gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mi sdug brjid la rngams/ /sna tshogs rgyan can go cha bgos/ /rdzu 'phrul rta chibs g.yon pa na/ /ne'u le bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ /ring po mig bzang gang po dang / /ser skya rnams ni shar phyogs srung / /seng ge nye ba'i seng ge dang / /dung can dga' bo lho phyogs srung / /seng ge seng ge'i ral pa dang / /bla ma ser skya nub phyogs srung / /'dzin pa 'dzin dga' brtson skyong dang / /khyab 'jug rnams ni byang phyogs srung / /lnga spyod tshig lnga gser ri mnyam/ /ser chen mtshams srung nor bu'i rigs/ /sa pa shin tu sa pa dang / /nag dang nye nag glang po rigs/ /phyogs bzhi gnas shing sa steng srung / /nyi zla me rlung ba glang rigs/ /mtshams bzhi gnas shing bar snang srung / /thams cad sku mdog dmar nag ste/ /cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal/

/go cha rab bgos gri phub 'dzin/ /sde dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po'i chos kyi spun gyur pa/ /dbang po zla ba chu lha dang / /bā ra dho dza skye dgu'i bdag /dbang ldan tsan+dan 'dod pa'i gtso/ /mgrin ngan mgul nges ba ṭi dang / /nor bu nor bu spyod sgra rab/ /nyer lnga po dang ri mnyam dang / /gser can gang po seng ldeng ba/ /g.yon phyogs lha dang ba glang skyong / /'brog gnas mi yi rgyal po dang / /rgyal ba'i khyu mchog tshig lnga ser/ /bzhin bzang ring po sna tshogs ste/ /'bras bu gsum pa mgul gsum pa/ /lcags mdung ring po dag dang ni/ /lha las byung ba'i ma ldan te/ /sa ga'i rigs te rdzu 'phrul can/ /ljang nag go cha ya lad bgos/ /kha dog ldan zhing dregs ldan pa'i/ /dmag dpon mdung dang ral gri 'dzin/ /phyogs bzhir gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdengs can dbang po mtha' yas dang / /nor rgyas bu dang 'jog po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /stobs kyi rgyu rnams gdengs kas brjid/ /spyi gtsug rin chen 'bar bas spras/ /nor gyi char 'bebs drag po yi/ /lta zer ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ /de nas spro na bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i thog mar nyan thos nyos lugs dang mthun par bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ khyod 'dur gdangs mdzad/ ni theg pa dman pa la/ /mos pa'i sems can don gyi phyir/ /nyan thos theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ /bstan skyong khyod la phyag 'tshal 'di yang rol mo gsum brdeg lan can/ lo/ /cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di yan chad mdzad/ khyod sngon mkha' lding rgyal po ni/ /'dur gdangs mdzad/ sgra snyan sgra chung spun gnyis kyis/ /klu rgyal dbugs dang dbugs chen gnyis/ /gtses shing rab tu skrag gyur nas/ /gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du bros/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'od srungs la/ /skyabs song bslab pa'i gzhi mnos pas/

/mkha' lding 'jigs bral bag yangs 'khod/ /de nas mkha' lding gnyis kyis kyang / /rgyu mtshan dris pas dad pa rnyed/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs zhabs song zhing / /bslab pa'i gzhi rnams yang dag mnos/ /'chi khar shākya thub pa de/ /mnyes par byed cing skye kun tu/ /gtso bor 'gyur bar smon lam btab/ /de mthus thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /dbugs dang dbugs chen yul 'khor srung / /'phags skyes por gyur sgra snyan ni/ /mig mi bzang gyur sgra chung ni/ /rnam thos sras zhes bya bar gyur/ /thub dbang lhums su zhugs pa nas/ /bltams dang rol rtsed mdzad pa dang / /khab tu bzhugs pa'i dus dag tu'ang / /rtag tu bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad/ /mngon par 'byung ba'i dus dag na'ang / /phyibs chibs min nam nas bteg ste gdan drangs shing / /rab byung dka' ba spyod dus su/ /nyin dang mtshan du mel tshe byed/ /thub chen mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /bsod snyoms len par bzhed pa'i tshe/ /khyod kyi rdo yi lhung bzed bzhi/ /grogs la'ang bsgos te cig car phul/ /ston pas gcig tu byin brlabs nas/ /nga la lhung bzed phul ba yis/ /rgyal chen chos kyi snod 'gyur zhes/ /lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bzung ste ston pa dang / /dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi/ /mchod dang srung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar byed/ /nam zhig thub pa'i dbang po ni/ /dal gyis 'bab pa'i mtsho 'gram du/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbus/ /gdan gyi gung la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /khyed sogs rgyal chen sde bzhi po/ /stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas/ /so so'i phyogs nas lhags nas ni/ /mchod pas mchod de 'khod pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gcig gis/ /so so'i skad du chos bstan pas/ /bzhi kas chos la chos kyi mig /rdul dang bral ba skyes gyur nas/ /bdag cag zhugs zhes ched du brjod/ /skyabs 'gro bslab pa'i gzhi bzung nas/

/de ltar thos kyang lan bdun gyis/ /srid mthar phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bzung ste dam pa'i chos/ /bzung zhing bsrung bar khas blangs shing / /'khor bzhi skyob par zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bstan srung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshe/ /kwa ye lha yi dbang po dag /nga ni myur du mya ngan 'da'/ /de 'og khyod kyis bstan pa srungs/ /bstan pa nub tu nye ba'i tshe/ /'jig rten chos min shas cher spyod/ /mu ge'i rims nad 'khrug pa dar/ /dge slong rnams kyang bslab la g.yel/ /de tshe ma rung mi rnams kyis/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten bshig /dge 'dun dag kyang gsod par byed/ /bstan la gnod chen byung ba'i tshe/ /khyed bzhi gcig tu bsdongs nas ni/ /bstan pa gces par srungs shig ces/ /ston pas zhal chems bzhag nas ni/ /bstan pa srung bar bskos pa bzhin/ /khyod kyang lha yi tshig bden pas/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /bstan pa gces par bsrung ngo zhes/ /zhal gyis bzhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas byung ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i tshul du bstod pa 'di nyid bya ste/ khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dman mos sems can don gyi phyir/ /nyan thos 'phags pa'i tshul ston pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di yan chad mdzad/ khyod sngon bskal pa grangs med nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad/ /'phags mchog brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la/ /rnam sras bden pa'i zla bar gyur/ /rin chen bdun las byas pa'i gdugs/ /thub dbang la phul 'di skad gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs las bdag nyid kyi/ /chos kyi rnam grangs bzung bar bgyi/ /pha rol la yang bstan par bgyi/ /bdag gi bsam pa de 'dra'o/ /sangs rgyas dpag med skyobs pa la/

/bdag gis gdung 'di phul ba yis/ /bdag ni thub pa khyod 'dra bar/ /spyi gtsug bltar yang mi gdar gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs smon lam btab/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i nus mthu yis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mngon sum du/ /khyod la 'di skad lung bstan mdzad/ /khyod ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ /dga' ldan du yang skye bar 'gyur/ /dga' ldan gnas nas shi 'phos nas/ /sangs rgyas byams pa la sogs pa/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /mthong zhing kun la mchod byas nas/ /bskal pa stong phrag nyi shur ni/ /mchod pa byas nas rab byung ste/ /tshangs par spyod pa rab spyad nas/ /bskal pa bye ba drug cu na/ /khyod ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni legs brgyan par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs/ /zhes bya bar ni sangs rgyas te/ /'khor ni byang sems sha stag la/ /khyod ni chos rnams ston par 'gyur/ /tshe yi tshad ni bskal pa gcig /dam chos bskal ba phyed du gnas/ /zhes gsungs mngon sum lung bstan pas/ /sa brgyad brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni bstan pa bzung ba'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos/ /zab mo gang dang gang gsungs pa/ /der ni khyod 'khor sde dang bcas/ /lhags nas gus pas nyan byed cing / /mdo sde 'di dang 'di 'dzin pa'i/ /gang zag bsrung zhing skyabs pa dang / /mdo sde gnas pa'i sa phyogs kyang / /yongs su bskyangs zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ /gang du mdo sde 'chad pa 'di/ /bdag cag dpung bcas 'khor dang bcas/ /'ongs nas mchod cing bsrung ngo zhes/ /mdo sde phal cher gsungs pa'i tshe/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar mngon sum du/ /btags pa'i ngag gis dam bcas pa'i/ /chos skyong chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bstod pa 'di yang bya ste/ khyod 'dur gdangs mdzad/

cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di yan chad mdzad/ ni rdo rje theg pa ma lus kyi/ /sgor zhugs bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang bskur te/ /rgyud sde ma lus bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /bstan srung chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rol mo gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ khyod ni gtsang ma'i gnas kyi 'og min du/ 'dur gdangs mdzad/ /'jam dpal rnam 'phrul rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad bstan pa bsrung ba ru/ /bka' bsgos zhal gyis bzhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin bde gshegs rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /phal cher khyod bcug dbang bskur rgyud gtad nas/ /bka' bsgos dam bcas de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /rigs kyi rgyud sde 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni don zhags rnam grol dkyil 'khor la/ /sogs par dbang bskur rgyud gtad bka' bsgos te/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud sde ma lus pa/ /skyong bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni phyag rdor rigs mchog dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos te/ /rdo rje rigs kyi rgyud sde ma lus pa/ /skyong bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni nor bu'i rigs kyi bdag po ste/ /stong phrag sum cu'i nor gyi bdag por bshad/ /khyod kyis pha yis kyang ni 'bum phrag bshad/ /de ltar nor bu bzang po nor rigs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor phal cher dbang bskur nor bu yi/ /rigs kyi bdag por bka' bsgos dbang bskur bas/ /'gro ba kun gyi dbul ba sel ba yi/ /nor rigs rgyud sde 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rigs mchog lnga rtsen dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pas/ /rgyas pa'i rigs kyi rgyud sde thams cad kyang / /skyong bar byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs la brten pa yin/ /'khyams po'i rigs kyang bsrung bar zhal bzhes te/ /bya ba'i rigs kyi rgyud sde sgo drug po/

/bsrung zhing skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dpal yon can gyi grong khyer du/ /phyag rdor dbang bskur rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor cher/ /bcug ste dbang bskur dbyug tho rdo rje can/ /lag tu gtad nas khri phrag 'khor dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos gnyer gtad pas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi rgyud sde skyong mdzad pa/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i gang zag bu bzhin srung / /spyod rgyud bstan pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni mi g.yo khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur rgyud sde bsrung bar bka' bsgos pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud sde rnams/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan srung ste/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rdo rje pad+ma dang / /nor bu'i rigs dang rdo rje 'chang gi rigs/ /gces par bsrung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri rab rtse mo de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bcug ste dbang bskur zhing / /ral gri gtad nas rdo rje 'jigs byed ces/ /mtshan btags de bzhin gshegs rigs bsrung bar bsgos/ /khyod ni chos dbyings gsung dbang dkyil 'khor du/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi par bcug ste dbang bskur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud sde kun/ /skyong bar byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sngon khams gsum rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug ste dbang bskur rin chen cod pan dang / /dar dpyangs byin nas lag tu rdo rje dang / /dbyid pa gtad nas rdo rje 'jigs byed ces/ /gsang ba'i mtshan btags mdog sngo ro langs zhon/ /lus ngan mo yang rdo rje zhags pa gtad/ /rdo rje 'khyor mar mtshan gsol rdo rje yi/ /rigs kyi rgyud sde skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sngon gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pho brang du/ /dpal mchog dang po'i chos dang las rigs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sngar bzhin dbang bskur te/
