/chos dang las rigs skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug ste sngar bzhin dbang bskur mtshan btags te/ /rdo rje 'chang rigs rgyud sde thams cad kyang / /bsrung zhing skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sngon gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pho brang du/ /nor gter gnod sbyin mo yi dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug ste dngos grub ster bar bka' bsgos shing / /nor gyi char pa 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshin rje gshed sogs dkyil 'khor du/ /phyogs skyong bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing / /sgrub po skyong zhing bar chad kun sel bas/ /pha rgyud bstan pa skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje 'chang gis dbang bskur byin brlabs nas/ /gsang mtshan drag po chen por mtshan gsol te/ /ma rgyud bstan pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ /ma rgyud dkyil 'khor phal cher dbang bskur zhing / /tshang tshing 'khrig pa'i dur khrod skyong bar bskos/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten du/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor cher/ /dbang bskur phyogs skyong bstan pa bsrung bar bskos/ /gnyis med rgyud sde skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg gi rjes su chems brdung dang bcas/ rang gi 'dod pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ de nas rol mo che ba gnyis brdeg la/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma yongs grags bzhin dang / 'di la spros na mgon po'i gtor 'bul skabs bzhin gyi dbyangs byed na mgor rol mo chems brdung gi mjug che ba gnyis kyi rjes su gsum brdeg ring ba blangs la de nas dbyangs ring thung rnams rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/ rgyun par phal cher shar ma mdzad do/ /'gro 'di'i tshigs bcad gnyis la srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma'i khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs kyi gdangs thung rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/

la phan bde ma lus skyed pa'i rgyu/ /thub bstan skyon med yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin gang zag mchog rnams chos 'phel zhing / /chos kyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog /skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa dang / /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs dang / /chos nyid rnam dag ldan pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par shog /ces brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can byas la bzhag de nas tshogs 'khor yod na ci 'byor pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams la/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du tshogs kyi yo byad rnams kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ tshogs mchod ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal chen 'khor bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /dpal 'byor nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur shog /ces brjod cing phud bla ma yi dam chos skyong la phul/ bar pa dngos grub kyi bsam pas longs spyod lhag ma bsdus te/ oṃ u tsi tra ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa ye swāhā skabs 'dir lhag ma bsdus pa la chang gis bran la phyir dor ba dang mnyam du rol mo chems brdungs/ dkar dung sogs med pa yon ji ltar rigs pa byas la/ de nas rol mo che ba gnyis brdeg la bzhag go /lhag ma 'di bzhin bya bar yi ge rnying pa 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba bzhin 'dir yang bkod pa yin mod kyi rang lugs kyi lag len la rnam sras kyi skabs 'dir lhag ma'i cho ga 'di bzhin mi bya ste/ bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las nor lha sgo bsdom bya ba yin pas gtor ma'i lha la gshegs gsol mi byed/

gnod sbyin zhal bsngo'i tshogs 'khor la tshogs lhag mi sdud pa phyag len yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad tshims par gyur cig ces brjod pas lhag ma bsngos la rol mo dang bcas pas phyir btang ngo / /gong ltar yang cho ga rdzogs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs bya la/ rang phyag na rdo rje gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gnas srung chen po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang / dge ba 'di yi nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /zhes sogs yongs grags bzhin brjod pas dge ba bsngo zhing / bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis gang 'os kyi mthar rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya zhing / dga' ston rgya chen po la rol lo/ /de dag ni cho ga byas pa'i phyogs te/ de las cung zad bsdus na mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed phyag rdor bsgoms pa/ mdun bskyed bskyed bstim/ mchod 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa bya ba/ bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul/ bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba/ bstod chen nas byung ba'i bshags pa mchod 'bul/ zhi drag gi 'phrin las bskul ba rnams sngar bzhin byas la bstod chen gyi gnas bstod dang / gtso bo'i thugs la bstod pa yan chad/ sras dang 'khor la bstod pa sngar bzhin dang / nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshul dang / rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bstod pa rnams dbu nas sh+lau ka re re bya zhing de nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma nas rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar sngar bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /de las kyang bsdu na/ bdag bskyed nas gtor 'bul yan sngar bzhin byas la/ rin chen pho brang dam pa nas/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa dang /

hūm̐ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /zhes sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol ba gnyis bzhag la/ bstod chen gyi bshags le/ mchod le/ zhi drag gi 'phrin las bskul ba rnams sngar bzhin byas la/ de nas gong du bzhag pa'i bstod pa dang 'phrin las bcol ba gnyis skabs 'dir byas la/ de nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma man chad sngar bzhin byas pas don tshang ba nyid do/ /de ltar ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes byas sbyar/ /legs byas 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro kun gyi/ /sgrib kun byang nas 'di dang phyi ma'i don/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin kun 'grub ste/ /srid mthar bstan 'gro'i don dngos 'grub par shog /bdag bcag so skye rang stobs mthu bral yang / /rgyal chen 'khor bcas mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob tshe ring dbang po gsal/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can bsgrod mdzod/ /ces rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi mchod pa'i cho ga 'di yang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs la yan lag mchog gis reg pa/ sa skya pa chos med snyoms las mkhan sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i drung du/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras rigs mi 'dra ba lnga phrag gsum gyi rjes gnang dang / de'i rgyud dang / man ngag gi tshogs rgya bod kyi yi ge tshad ldan po ti gnyis tsam du longs pa'i lung dang zhal shes du ma phyag khrid dang bcas bka' drin nos pa la brten/ dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog bla brang gi phun tshogs yongs 'du'i gnyer khang chen mo'i bya 'dabs su rnam thos sras kyi lha khang lcang lo can zhes bya ba gsar du bcas pa der/

lo ltar gyi gtor gzhi 'dzugs pa'i slad du/ rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs pa rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan par bsams nas/ 'di skor gyi yig cha bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab tshad ldan du ma nas btus te/ nyi ma zhes pa chu mo lug gi lo/ cho 'phrul gyi zla ba phyi ma'i dmar cha rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la gzhi thog bla brang gi bkra shis brtsegs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa dang yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis/ 'di bgyis dge bas rgya chen 'khor bcas kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring nad med dbang po rab tu gsal ba sogs kyi dngos grub stsol ba dang / phyi ma 'bral med lhan cig bde ba can du thogs med skye bar gyur cig /ka l+yān war+dhan+tu/ zhes rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter mdzod ces sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa 'di rnams la spyir 'khrul pa'i dri ma phra mo tsam yang ci la mnga'/ 'on kyang gsung rtsom 'di nyid kyi gzhi rten bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rnam sras kyi mngon rtogs dgos 'dod 'byung ba dang / bstod chen rgyal po'i thugs rab tu mnyes byed/ ngor chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs dang / rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs dang gtor chog dgos 'dod kun 'byung rnams la mdzad pas/ de dag tu gsal zhing a mes zhabs kyi gsung tsam 'dir ma 'thus pa'i chad lhag byung ngam snyam pa'i som nyi can rnams la/ gong gi rigs kyi tsha bor skyes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bu ston rin po che yab sras dang /
